newsitem.title: USA: American Financial sees Q3 gain and charges.
newsitem.headline: American Financial sees Q3 gain and charges.

text.p: American Financial Group Inc said on Friday that it expects to record a third quarter pretax gain of about $160 million from the sale of its stake in Citicasters Inc to Jacor Communications Inc.
The Citicasters and Jacor merger was closed this week, the company said.

The company also said it sees a third quarter non-cash, pre-tax charge of about $80 million arising from its decision to increase its insurance reserves relating to asbestos and other environmental matters.
Additionally, the company said it expects losses from Hurricane Fran to be between $30 and $40 million, net of reinsurance.
Apart from Hurricane Fran, the company said that third quarter underwriting results are expected to be improved from the second quarter.

The company said it estimates that its reserves for asbestos and other environmental matters at September 30 will be about $340 million, an amount expected to be about 11 times the preceding three years' average claim payments.
